oauth2Authorize.description: Authorize an OAuth 2.1 request from query parameters or an application/x-www-form-urlencoded POST body

parameters.name: request_uri
parameters.description: Pushed Authorization Request URI referencing stored parameters

parameters.name: max_age
parameters.description: Maximum authentication age in seconds; forces re-authentication when exceeded

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Requested protected resource(s) for the access token. May be supplied multiple times as repeated 'resource' query parameters (RFC 8707) or as an array of strings.

302.description: Redirect to client with code or error

Location.description: Redirect URI with code or error

redirect_uri.description: The URI to redirect to, either with an authorization code or an error
The URI to redirect to, either with an authorization code or an error

parameters.name: DPoP
parameters.description: RFC 9449 DPoP proof JWT for issuing DPoP-bound tokens

resource.description: Requested protected resource(s) for the access token

access_token.description: The access token issued by the authorization server

token_type.description: The type of the token issued

expires_in.description: Lifetime in seconds of the access token

scope.description: Scopes granted by the access token

oauth2Introspect.description: Introspect an OAuth2 access or refresh token

token.description: The token to introspect (access or refresh token)

token_type_hint.description: Hint about the token type. Recognized values: `access_token`, `refresh_token`.

client_id.description: Client ID associated with the token

exp.description: Expiration time of the token (seconds since epoch)

oauth2Revoke.description: Revoke an OAuth2 access or refresh token

token.description: The token to revoke (access or refresh token)

token_type_hint.description: Hint about the token type. Recognized values: `access_token`, `refresh_token`.

200.description: Token revoked successfully. The response body is empty.

oauth2UserInfo.description: Get OpenID Connect user information (UserInfo endpoint)

parameters.name: DPoP
parameters.description: RFC 9449 DPoP proof JWT when using a DPoP-bound access token

email.description: User's email address, included if 'email' scope is granted

name.description: User's full name, included if 'profile' scope is granted

picture.description: User's profile picture URL, included if 'profile' scope is granted

given_name.description: User's given name, included if 'profile' scope is granted

family_name.description: User's family name, included if 'profile' scope is granted

email_verified.description: Whether the email is verified, included if 'email' scope is granted

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing access token

oauth2EndSession.description: RP-Initiated Logout endpoint. Accepts standard logout parameters through GET or an application/x-www-form-urlencoded POST body, plus JSON for Better Auth generated-client calls. Requests without a usable id_token_hint may require explicit OP confirmation.

200.description: Logout completed, or an HTML confirmation page was returned for browser navigation. A redirect is used only for an exact registered post_logout_redirect_uri.

redirect_uri.description: URI to redirect to after logout (if post_logout_redirect_uri was provided)

client_secret_expires_at.description: Time the client secret will expire. If 0, the client secret will never expire.

scope.description: Space-separated scopes allowed by the client

user_id.description: ID of the user who registered the client, null if registered anonymously

contacts.description: List representing ways to contact people responsible for this client, typically email addresses

software_id.description: Unique identifier assigned by the developer to help in the dynamic registration process

software_statement.description: JWT containing metadata values about the client software as claims

post_logout_redirect_uris.description: List of allowed logout redirect uris

backchannel_logout_uri.description: RP URL to receive signed Logout Tokens when the end-user's OP session terminates

backchannel_logout_session_required.description: Whether the RP requires a `sid` claim in every Logout Token

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: Requested authentication method for the token endpoint

grant_types.description: Grant types the client may use at the token endpoint

response_types.description: Response types the client may use at the authorization endpoint

application_type.description: OIDC application type used to classify redirect URI policy

resources.description: Final resource identifiers linked to the registered client
